title: Canal Pole Vault
tagline: Plant, climb and leap the canal
description: Sprint, plant a long pole in a Dutch canal, climb as it swings over the upright and let go to land on the far sand bed. Four canals, a lifelike jumper and a real pendulum pole.
howToPlay: Tap on the beat to build speed, then tap once to plant at the board.
Hold to climb the pole once it swings over the upright, release to rest.
Choose a lean and let go to land as far as you can on the sand.
